newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-7 overs stall Maxwell's NZ cricket career.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-7 overs stall Maxwell's NZ cricket career.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Nov 1 - New Zealand Cricket's marketing manager Neil Maxwell has just learned that seven overs he bowled for Australia A against the West Indies last summer have denied him any opportunity of playing for New Zealand this summer.
Maxwell was born in Fiji and spent the first seven years of his life there before his parents returned to Australia.
That made him eligible, under the International Cricket Council's laws, to play for New Zealand immediately if it wasn't for those seven overs for Australia A.
He now faces a two-year stand-down period before being considered.
Maxwell, who is based in Christchurch, is keen to play for Canterbury this season.
